notes.title: Gym Manager - full game released!
notes.content:
[h1][b]🌟 Hey Gym Managers! 🌟[/b][/h1]

[h3][b]It's time for the grand opening! Gym Manager is live, and from today, you can dive into the world of managing your own gym! 🏋️‍♂️✨

Build, expand, and manage your fitness empire. Ready to become the best manager in town? Exciting challenges and loads of fun await you![/b][/h3]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43798396/7ba8f9bcf49270a1dc14bba57481963eeeea56d6.png[/img]

[b]We want to hear your suggestions, opinions, requests, and any other ideas. Your feedback is incredibly important to us and will help make Gym Manager even better![/b]

So, what are you waiting for? Jump into the game today and show us what you’ve got! 💪See you at the gym!

[b]If you're interested in other games in a similar climate, don't forget to check out the Bundle deals! [/b]
